integrity: The proof separates the analytic phase-flow argument from a finite exact certificate. The packaged verifier uses only integer and rational arithmetic for the \(64\)-point moment and affine-rank checks; no numerical approximation is used to infer the exact existence statement.
scientific_limitations: The result settles only the \(q=9\), \(N=8\) path and does not classify the other unresolved composite moduli.
The proof establishes existence of a time distribution with at most \(17\) atoms but does not provide explicit readout times.
The claim concerns randomized uniform average mixing, not instantaneous uniform mixing or pretty good state transfer.
title: The eight-site uniform XY chain admits exact uniform average mixing under random readout
